scenario: RLOW.5.4 — a negated temporal-window pattern (`no X within T`) lowers to a Rete network whose NOT beta re-evaluates on every pump tick through a synthetic `$ClockTick` beta. The compiler must register the `$ClockTick` schema for negated-`within` rules, not only for after-clause / timeout programs; otherwise the Rete loader rejects the alpha node with 'schema not registered'. Pin: a rule with `no AE e within 20min` and no after-clause loads under the native Rete engine and fires (the negation holds when no AE fact is present).
rules_ds:
schema P scope logical:
    id: Int key
    ts: Time

schema AE scope ttl 60s:
    kind: String
    ts: Time

rule t cooldown 5min:
    P
    no AE e within 20min where e.kind == "x"
->
    log info "e"
